name: fairclinic-sterilization-logs
description: Fairclinic Sterilization Logs: gaps and open items in sterilizer cycle logs and spore test logs: entries without a result, number or initials, failed cycles with no rerun logged, missing cycle numbers, long gaps between spore tests while a sterilizer was in use, and positive spore tests with no retest logged. A log completeness check, never a compliance determination.
